elements.requirement: A local housing authority may impose a financial penalty on a person if it is satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that the person has committed an offence under section 1 in relation to premises in England.
elements.quote: A local housing authority may impose a financial penalty on a person if satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that the person has committed an offence under section 1 in relation to premises in England.

elements.requirement: A local housing authority must not impose a financial penalty in respect of conduct amounting to an offence under section 1 if the person has been convicted of an offence under that section in respect of that conduct.
elements.quote: No financial penalty may be imposed in respect of any conduct amounting to an offence under section 1 if— (a) the person has been convicted of an offence under that section in respect of the conduct

elements.requirement: A local housing authority must not impose a financial penalty in respect of conduct amounting to an offence under section 1 if criminal proceedings for an offence under that section in respect of that conduct have been instituted against the person and have not been concluded.
elements.quote: criminal proceedings for an offence under that section in respect of the conduct have been instituted against the person and the proceedings have not been concluded

elements.requirement: A local housing authority must not impose a financial penalty in respect of conduct amounting to an offence under section 1 if criminal proceedings for an offence under that section in respect of that conduct have been concluded and the person has not been convicted of the offence.
elements.quote: criminal proceedings for an offence under that section in respect of the conduct have been concluded and the person has not been convicted of the offence.

elements.requirement: The local housing authority imposing a financial penalty under section 1A must determine its amount, which must not exceed £40,000.
elements.quote: The amount of a financial penalty imposed under this section is to be determined by the authority imposing it, but must not be more than £40,000.

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State may issue guidance to local housing authorities regarding the exercise of their functions under section 1A.
elements.quote: The Secretary of State may give guidance to local housing authorities about the exercise of their functions under this section.

elements.requirement: Local housing authorities are required to have regard to any guidance issued by the Secretary of State under subsection (4).
elements.quote: Local housing authorities must have regard to any guidance issued under subsection (4).

elements.requirement: Schedule A1 governs the procedure for imposing financial penalties, appeals against them, their enforcement, and how local housing authorities deal with penalty proceeds.
elements.quote: Schedule A1 makes provision about— (a) the procedure for imposing financial penalties, (b) appeals against financial penalties, (c) enforcement of financial penalties, and (d) how local housing authorities are to deal with the proceeds of financial penalties.

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State may make regulations amending the maximum financial penalty amount specified in subsection (3) to reflect changes in the value of money.
elements.quote: The Secretary of State may by regulations amend the amount specified in subsection (3) to reflect changes in the value of money.

elements.requirement: Regulations made under section 1A must be made by statutory instrument.
elements.quote: Regulations under this section are to be made by statutory instrument.

elements.requirement: A statutory instrument containing regulations under section 1A is subject to annulment pursuant to a resolution of either House of Parliament.
elements.quote: A statutory instrument containing regulations under this section is subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament.

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 1A and Schedule A1, a 'local housing authority' is defined as a district council, a county council in England for an area without a district council, a London borough council, the Common Council of the City of London, or the Council of the Isles of Scilly.
elements.quote: “local housing authority” means a district council, a county council in England for an area for which there is no district council, a London borough council, the Common Council of the City of London or the Council of the Isles of Scilly.
